source.author: verg
source.text: At pius Aeneas arces, quibus altus Apollo praesidet, horrendaeque procul secreta Sibyllae antrum immane petit, magnum cui mentem animumque Delius inspirat vates, aperitque futura.
source.text_original: At pius Aeneas arces, quibus altus Apollo / praesidet, horrendaeque procul secreta Sibyllae / antrum immane petit, magnum cui mentem animumque / Delius inspirat vates, aperitque futura.
source.text_english: But dutiful Aeneas makes for the citadel, over which lofty Apollo presides, and the awful, remote, secluded cavern of the Sibyl, vast in extent, to whom the Delian prophet breathes great mind and spirit and reveals the future.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: tu sola animos mentesque peruris, Gloria; te viridem videt immunemque senectae Phasidis in ripa stantem iuvenesque vocantem.
reuse.text_original: tu sola animos mentesque peruris, / Gloria; te viridem videt immunemque senectae / Phasidis in ripa stantem iuvenesque vocantem.
reuse.text_english: you alone, Glory, burn up minds and hearts; the Phasis sees you standing on its bank, green and free from old age, and calling the young men.
